_comment: Maintainerr rule groups, applied by maintainerr-wire.sh (Homelab #565). Each group fills a Plex
collection for REVIEW. The script forces arrAction=DO_NOTHING and deleteAfterDays=null on every
group whatever this file says, so nothing here can delete. Groups are matched by name.
Ids are [application, property] from GET /api/rules/constants (v3.29.0):
Plex 0: addDate=0 viewCount=5 lastViewedAt=7 sw_lastWatched=13 sw_amountOfViews=17 watchlist_isWatchlisted=30
Sonarr 2: ended=7
action: EQUALS=2 BEFORE=5 NOT_EXISTS=19.  operator: AND=0 OR=1 (null on the very first rule).
customVal ruleTypeId: 0=number (for a date rule: SECONDS ago), 3=boolean.
Booleans are "1"/"0", NOT "true"/"false": the comparator does +value, so "false" becomes NaN and
the rule fails for EVERY item. Verified live — the first version matched nothing because of it.
Rules in one section combine with their own operator; a section's FIRST rule carries the
operator that joins it to the previous sections. So each group reads: section 0 AND (section 1).
Why 'never watched' is its own rule: BEFORE is false when lastViewedAt is missing, so an unwatched
title would otherwise never match 'last watched more than N days ago'.
It is 'last viewed NOT_EXISTS', not 'view count = 0': Plex counts a started-but-unfinished play as
0 views while still recording when it happened, so viewCount=0 flagged titles opened weeks ago
(The Perfect Blue, 55 days; Noblesse, 54 days). Something mid-watch is not a cleanup candidate.
Shows use Plex lastViewedAt (0,7) too, not sw_lastWatched (0,13): the latter counts FINISHED episodes
only, so a show opened 54 days ago still read as never watched.
NO TRACEARR RULE, deliberately. Tracearr (connected, 2.4.1) answers UNKNOWN - not 'never played' -
for any title added before its history starts (2026-06-24) that it has not seen play, and an
unknown result FREEZES that title's collection membership. Every current candidate predates June,
and added dates never move, so a Tracearr condition would permanently stop old titles from ever
being added. Verified live 2026-09-23 (rule test on Paprika; tracearr-getter.service.ts).
